location_answer.en: We are located in Lavale, Pune, accessible via the Pashan - Sus Road.
location_answer.hi: हम लवले, पुणे में स्थित हैं, यहाँ पाषाण-सूस रोड के माध्यम से पहुँचा जा सकता है।
location_answer.mr: आमचे रुग्णालय लवळे, पुणे येथे असून पाषाण-सूस रोडने येथे पोहोचता येते.

nearby_hotels_answer: Yes, there are several hotels and guest houses in the Lavale and Sus area. Our helpdesk can provide a list.
bus_answer: Yes, PMPML buses ply regularly to the Lavale campus from various parts of Pune.
railway_station_answer: The hospital is approximately 18-20 km from Pune Railway Station. It usually takes 45-60 minutes by taxi.
